comment: Every code of contract 1, with where it comes from, its level, when it is given, and one sentence that says what to do.
from: bridge (a rejected call of something.js), check (something check), import (opening a .something export).
level: fatal (the check could not run), error, warning, info. A bridge code is the code of a rejected promise;
check reports a bridge rejection a real engine would also give as BRIDGE_ERROR, which carries that code.
blocks: true when the space is not displayed. Within contract 1 codes are added, never removed or renamed.

BAD_PARAMS.when: A parameter is missing or of the wrong type.
BAD_PARAMS.fix: Pass the parameters the guide lists for this function, with their types.

UNKNOWN_METHOD.when: The function is not in this contract.
UNKNOWN_METHOD.fix: Use only the functions of something.js listed in the guide.

UNKNOWN_EVENT.when: on with an event other than change or granted.

NO_HOST.when: The page is not open in something.
NO_HOST.fix: Open the space in something; a browser alone has no agents to give it.

RIGHT_NOT_GRANTED.when: The right was not declared, was refused, or was revoked.
RIGHT_NOT_GRANTED.fix: Declare the right, and read something.granted to hide what the person did not allow.

AGENT_NOT_FOUND.when: No such agent in this space's scope.
AGENT_NOT_FOUND.fix: Use an id from the latest state; agents come and go.

READ_ONLY_AGENT.when: A write to an agent started elsewhere.
READ_ONLY_AGENT.fix: Check can before writing; offer resume to continue this conversation here.

NOT_SUPPORTED.when: This agent cannot do it (its can says false).
NOT_SUPPORTED.fix: Check can and because before the call, and hide what this agent cannot do.

VALUE_NOT_OFFERED.when: set with a value not in options, or the agent replied with a different value.
VALUE_NOT_OFFERED.fix: Pick a value from the agent's options.

AGENT_STOPPED.fix: Launch or resume an agent to go on.

FOLDER_NOT_GRANTED.when: launch with a folder outside the granted one.
FOLDER_NOT_GRANTED.fix: Launch in something.granted.folder or a folder inside it.

NOT_INSTALLED.when: The agent's program was not found on this Mac.
NOT_INSTALLED.fix: Tell the person to install this agent; kinds says which ones are installed.

INTERPRETER_NOT_FOUND.when: The program was found, but what it needs to run was not.
INTERPRETER_NOT_FOUND.fix: Show the message to the person: it names what to install.

LAUNCH_FAILED.when: The program started and stopped at once.
LAUNCH_FAILED.fix: Show the message to the person: it carries the agent's first error line.

THREAD_NOT_FOUND.when: No conversation with this id can be resumed.
THREAD_NOT_FOUND.fix: Use a thread id from the latest state.

STILL_RUNNING.when: Another process still holds this conversation.
STILL_RUNNING.fix: Show the message to the person: it says which process and what to do.

HELD_ELSEWHERE.when: A background service of the agent holds the conversation.
HELD_ELSEWHERE.fix: Show the message to the person: it names the gesture that frees it.

REFUSED.when: The person said no in a native window.
REFUSED.fix: Accept the answer; do not ask again in a loop.

BUSY.when: A link confirmation is already open for this space.
BUSY.fix: Wait for the first link's answer before opening another.

STORE_FULL.fix: Store less: remove old values with store.set(path, null).

AGENT_ERROR.fix: Show the message to the person: it keeps the agent's own words.

SPACE_NOT_FOUND.when: No space by that name or path.
SPACE_NOT_FOUND.fix: Give the name of a space in ~/something/spaces, or the path of its file or folder.

NO_WINDOW_SERVER.when: No logged-in Mac session to render in; only the static checks ran.
NO_WINDOW_SERVER.fix: Run the check from a logged-in session of the Mac.

STATE_FILE_UNREADABLE.when: The --state file is not a valid state.
STATE_FILE_UNREADABLE.fix: Start from share/contract/state-example.json and keep every key.

DECLARATION_UNREADABLE.when: The declaration is not valid JSON.
DECLARATION_UNREADABLE.fix: Fix the JSON of the declaration; the space does not open until it parses.

CONTRACT_TOO_NEW.when: contract is higher than this engine knows.

SCRIPT_ERROR.when: An uncaught error, with file, line and column.
SCRIPT_ERROR.fix: Fix the code at this line; the page stops running at this error.

PROMISE_REJECTED.fix: Catch the rejection and show its message to the person.

RESOURCE_MISSING.when: A file of the space that does not exist.
RESOURCE_MISSING.fix: Add the file to the space, or fix the path that names it.

LOAD_FAILED.fix: Check that the space's HTML file exists and is readable.

LOAD_TIMEOUT.fix: Make the page load faster: no endless loop before the first paint.

PAGE_CRASHED.fix: Look for code that uses too much memory or loops without end.

DECLARATION_MISSING.when: No declaration: the space opens with no right.

DECLARATION_TWICE.when: Both a block and something.json; something.json is used.
DECLARATION_TWICE.fix: Keep one declaration: remove the block or something.json.

SCOPE_INVALID.when: agents is not one of the two shapes; the space sees only what it launches.

UNKNOWN_RIGHT.when: A word that is not a right of contract 1.
UNKNOWN_RIGHT.fix: Use one of: state, send, launch, store, optionally with :kind.

RIGHT_UNAVAILABLE.when: A known right this engine cannot honour.
RIGHT_UNAVAILABLE.fix: Read something.granted.unavailable and hide what depends on it.

RIGHT_NOT_DECLARED.when: The page called a function whose right it did not declare.
RIGHT_NOT_DECLARED.fix: Declare the right in rights, or do not call this function.

RIGHT_REFUSED.when: With --refuse: the page threw instead of adapting to granted.
RIGHT_REFUSED.fix: Read something.granted and hide what the person refused.

RESOURCE_BLOCKED.when: A load outside the space was blocked (spaces have no network).
RESOURCE_BLOCKED.fix: Put the file in the space, or embed the library at an exact version.

NAVIGATION_BLOCKED.when: The page tried to leave the space.
NAVIGATION_BLOCKED.fix: Use something.open(url) for links that leave the space.

BRIDGE_ERROR.when: A bridge call a real engine would also reject (with its code).
BRIDGE_ERROR.fix: Read the code's own sentence, and check granted and can before the call.

CONSOLE_ERROR.fix: Show the problem to the person on the page, or fix its cause.

FOLDER_MISSING.when: The declared folder does not exist on this Mac.
FOLDER_MISSING.fix: Declare a folder that exists, or leave folder out and let the person choose one.

TOO_HEAVY.when: The space weighs more than 5 MB.
TOO_HEAVY.fix: Remove files the space does not use, or make its images smaller.

UNKNOWN_KEY.when: A declaration key this engine does not know; ignored.
UNKNOWN_KEY.fix: Remove the key, or check its spelling.

IMPORT_NOT_A_SPACE.when: The file is not a .something export.
IMPORT_NOT_A_SPACE.fix: Import a file made by something's export.

IMPORT_TOO_NEW.when: The export carries a contract higher than this engine knows.

IMPORT_UNSAFE_PATH.when: A file path is absolute, has .., or an empty or hidden segment.
IMPORT_UNSAFE_PATH.fix: Export the space again from something; this file was changed by hand.

IMPORT_TOO_BIG.fix: Remove files the space does not use, then export it again.
